planets.name: LHS 1903 e
planets.description: Transiting planet of LHS 1903 with a 29.3-day year, found in 2026.

text.card: LHS 1903 e was found in 2026 by CHEOPS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around LHS 1903. Its orbit and size follow Wilson et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
